title: Apostrophe and L
summary: Two new keys: apostrophe and L. The finger goes out, presses, and comes back.
intro: Two new keys in this lesson: apostrophe and L. They belong to your left little finger and your right little finger. The movement is always the same — out, press, back — and the way back is the part being trained, because a finger left out of place spoils the next letter.
congrats: Two more keys under your fingers. If apostrophe and L already come without searching, the lesson has done its job.

screens.text: This key belongs to your left little finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only ' and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.
This key belongs to your right little finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only L and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.
Short groups, one after another. Keep going to the end even if you miss one.
The new keys mixed with the old ones, which is how they will turn up inside words.
